::: {.callout-tip title="Live app"}
Once you deploy this week's Streamlit app, embed the **running app** here by replacing the placeholder URL below. The page will show the live, interactive app instead of static code.

```{=html}
<iframe
  src="https://YOUR-APP-NAME.streamlit.app/?embed=true"
  width="100%" height="600" style="border:1px solid #ddd; border-radius:8px;"
  loading="lazy">
</iframe>
```

To embed a Streamlit Community Cloud app, append `?embed=true` to its URL (this hides Streamlit's chrome). Until an app is deployed, leave this commented out or point it at a shared course demo.
:::
